prose: As we’ve explored, identity is the foundation of everything; it’s who you are in Christ before you lift a finger or check a single box. You are God’s beloved, redeemed, intentionally designed child. Your worth is not something you earn; it’s something you receive. It is not who you are but whose you are.

But God doesn’t stop at just being, He invites you into becoming. That’s where expertise comes in. Expertise is the tangible expression of your identity worked out over time. It’s the combination of your God-given talents, your life experiences, your practiced skills, and your growing wisdom. It’s what happens when the raw material of who you are gets shaped, refined, and multiplied to bless others.

Identity and expertise are like the roots and branches of a great oak tree. Without roots, the branches can’t stand; without branches, the roots never reach their full purpose. You were made to be deeply rooted in your identity so that what you do flows naturally from who you are. And here’s the best part: God’s not asking for instant perfection. He’s inviting you into a slow, faithful process of becoming, through trial, triumph, learning, failing, and trying again.
